beschreibung: The **Archiv** in **Außerfern** is a stylish bar that captivates with its inviting ambiance and a carefully curated drink menu. Whether you prefer classic cocktails, fine wines, or regional beers—every guest will find the perfect drink for an unforgettable evening. The interior blends modern design with cozy touches, creating a welcoming atmosphere that encourages you to stay awhile. Skilled bartenders are also happy to craft custom signature cocktails just for you, exclusive to this spot. Whether it’s a post-work meetup, a relaxed evening with friends, or the start of a long night out—**Archiv** provides the ideal setting for convivial moments in **Außerfern**.
